risks.title: Risks
risks.subtitle: What might go wrong, how likely, how bad, and who owns the mitigation — ranked by exposure.
risks.detailSubtitle: A risk might happen and needs mitigation. When it happens, promote it to an issue — the risk stays as the record it was foreseen.
risks.stale: Someone else changed this risk. It has been reloaded — please try again.
risks.scoreHow: Likelihood weight × impact weight (1–25). Worked out by the system.
risks.ruleOff: The risk rule is not yet agreed with the client, so exposure is not coloured.
risks.mitigationHelp: What is being done to make it less likely or less harmful.
risks.retireBody: {number} leaves the register. It can be restored later.
risks.promoteBody: The risk has happened. A new issue is raised with its title and description; the risk stays, marked materialised, as the record it was foreseen.
risks.materialisedNote: This risk has materialised. Its score, dates and wording are kept as the record it was foreseen; only its owner, area, solution and wave can still change.
risks.field.title: Title
